findings.title: Do not suppress unit omissions
findings.text: `unit_derived` is gated by `qualitative`, so when a qualitative-authored triple sits on a statement whose parse derives a unit, the author's omitted unit is reported `Ok` instead of `Omission` — the four-case table says a derived slot the author omitted must flag. Only `value` has the stray-number exemption; remove the gate from the unit slot and update `a_qualitative_triple_on_a_measurable_statement_still_flags_the_operator` to expect the unit omission.

findings.title: Show annotations beside flags
findings.text: When both slots are annotations, or one slot flags while the other annotates, the early `FLAG`/`ann value` returns drop the other annotation, so it becomes invisible — exactly what ADR 0014's amendment says must not happen. Build the cell from both slots so an annotation is always shown, including beside a flag.

findings.title: Validate the whole numeric string
findings.text: `authored_is_numeric` only checks the first character, despite its doc claiming a canonical decimal, so a digit-leading state name (`2-way`, `3rd_party`) is misread as a quantity and `is_qualitative_convention` stops recognizing it. Validate that the whole string is numeric so a state name that happens to start with a digit still classifies as the qualitative annotation.
